headline: Approved citywide ballots for the November 3, 2026 election and council at-large candidate placement set by lottery.
summary: Members held a lottery to set the order of council at-large candidates on the November 3, 2026 ballot. Alberto Rivas was drawn first and Tatiana Baena second. The citywide ballots and that placement were then approved.

transcript:
# City of Central Falls

## Board of Canvassers Emergency Meeting

Central Falls City Hall
580 Broad St. Central Falls, RI 02863

Wednesday, September 16, 2026

9:30 AM

## Minutes

1. **Roll Call**
   The meeting was called to order at 9:30 am by Member: John Marenzana, Member; and Belmiro Bala, Member; Candida Silva, Deputy City Clerk and Alberto DeBugo, City Clerk. A quorum was established

2. **Pledge of Allegiance**
   Member, John Marenzana led the board in the pledge of allegiance

3. The board will meet to hold a lottery to determine the council at large candidates' placement on General Election on November 3, 2026. Board members, John Marenzana and Belmiro Bala did a lottery and the first name that was chosen was Alberto Rivas and second was Tatiana Baena. A motion was made by Member, John Marenzana and seconded by Belmiro Bala. Motion passed 2/o.

4. The board will meet to approve the November 3, 2026 city wide ballots and the council at large candidate's lottery placement.
   A motion was made by Member, John Marenzana and seconded by Belmiro Bala. Motion passed 2/o.

5. **Adjournment**
   Meeting called to adjournment at 9:39 am. The motion was made by John Marenzana Member, and seconded by Belmiro Bala. passed 2/O
